Acme

Welcome to Acme

Acme helps teams ship better interfaces faster. This is a single-page app whose views are reached by clicking the nav — there are no anchor links to crawl.

Everything here renders client-side. The analyzer must click the nav controls to discover the hidden views.

Features

Overview of the feature set — a full content panel that swaps when you switch tabs. These inner tabs are a second level of navigation nested under Features.

Each panel is structurally distinct (prose vs. table vs. accordion) so the explorer's visibility-aware signature recognises them as separate sub-views.
